observations: The package-only JTest consumer could initialize capabilities only by supplying source-root material and received no deterministic success output.
The CLI has no no-argument or --help contract and exposes required values one parser failure at a time.
Provider refresh leaves earlier wrappers discoverable while the lock remembers only the last provider.
A JTest gate-design agent had to inspect DLL strings and iteratively guess analyzer package identity, collection order, artifact null semantics, and UTF-8 BOM requirements.

The CLI already composes finite schema modules, diagnostic catalogs, and backed gate operations, but exposes no exact knowledge-closure, readiness, schema/resource, diagnostic-remediation, artifact-interpretation, or gate-definition materialization boundary.

The repository catalog marks a consumer-facing local-publish capability available while excluding it from the five-definition consumer bundle; contributor-only and unavailable roles are not machine-readable.
A schema alone cannot supply capability procedure, trigger, authority, command, migration, package-selection, troubleshooting, or remediation knowledge.

staticConformanceDisposition.scope: The gate is bound once at Program Kit repository scope; this design only references that established binding because its C# edits are covered.

implementationBoundary.acceptedOutcome: One package-only Program Kit CLI journey supplies a read-only, complete, readiness-verified knowledge closure for every consumer-role capability, exact troubleshooting and interpretation, correct supported-provider triggers, initialization/refresh, canonical gate materialization, and installed Console generation without source checkout or reverse engineering.

overlapDisposition.consumedOutcome: Consumer capability contract migration, thin wrapper regeneration, bundle digest refresh, and clean initialization/refresh proof are performed inside PKCJ-W010 and must not be repeated.

doesNotAuthorize: material deviation from the exact design or plan
a second partial implementation work unit
JTest or other consumer repository mutation
package-feed publication or GitHub Release creation
remaining routing, contributor, approval, handback, or release-cycle health work
version selection beyond the not-yet-delivered 0.1.0-alpha.2 candidate
a claim of protection against a malicious same-user executable edit without an external read-only installation boundary
release, promotion, deployment, signing, hooks, watchers, MCP bindings, or autonomous work

validation.commandAndSchemaFeasibility: passed against the current self-contained CLI, finite descriptor catalog, registered schema modules, stable diagnostic catalogs, capability bundle, gate contracts, validator, and pack metadata
validation.knowledgeClosureCompleteness: designed as a mechanically verified transitive closure over all six consumer-role capabilities; consumer-repository facts, human decisions, external state, and malicious same-user executable modification remain explicit non-product trust boundaries
validation.readOnlyKnowledgeBoundary: canonical knowledge is embedded, has no mutation/export API, is never copied into the consumer workspace, and is verified before use; thin wrapper modification invalidates preflight/read
validation.staticConformanceDisposition: reuse-existing at repository scope with exact current private gate and activation matrix
validation.artifactDigests: passed by SHA-256 recalculation over exact UTF-8 LF bytes
validation.schemaInstantiation: not applicable: this transitional amendment deliberately does not create another legacy high-major design or plan contract
